title: Taiwanese American Student Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) at Vanderbilt University is a registered student organization serving the Taiwanese and Taiwanese American community on campus. The organization is formally recognized by Vanderbilt’s Student Center for Belonging and Communities (SCBC), which lists TASA among its advised cultural organizations, and holds an official registration on the university’s Anchor Link platform.

TASA participates actively in campus-wide cultural programming. In October 2025, the organization contributed a booth to the Asian American Student Association’s annual Night Market on Commons Lawn, representing Taiwanese culture through traditional night market games and beverages. The organization maintains an Instagram presence under the handle @vandytasa, where it documents events and community activities for its campus following.
